name: bg-store-night
prompt: A CONVENIENCE STORE INTERIOR LATE AT NIGHT: a hot-food counter with a stainless oden pot of simmering broth and skewers, a tall glass drinks fridge glowing cold, a magazine rack, a coffee machine, a wire basket of steamed buns, a checkout counter with a small mat. Through the front window a dark empty street with one street lamp. THIS IS NOT A BEDROOM. No bed, no computer desk. Flat overhead fluorescent light, slightly too bright for the hour, cold cyan on every surface. IMPORTANT STYLE RULES: same overall BRIGHTNESS as the reference images, do NOT make this darker or more cinematic; same SATURATED blue-violet and lilac palette with cyan accents, do NOT desaturate toward grey; same FLAT lofi-anime cel shading, minimal gradients, no depth-of-field, no bloom. No readable text anywhere.
